purpose: Compare five-seed LIME consensus explanations with exact local TreeSHAP explanations on the same 12 cross-model disagreement cases.
comparison_note: LIME and SHAP attribution magnitudes are in different output spaces. Comparisons therefore emphasize ranks, overlap, cosine similarity and direction rather than direct numerical equality.
agreement_metrics: sign agreement on shared top-10 features
operational_reliability_warning: Reliability labels are study-specific descriptive categories and are not universal XAI standards.
